data.name: Addiel
data.long_meaning:
Derived from the Hebrew roots ‘Ad’ (God) and ‘Dalet’ (path or way), this name signifies that God is the source of righteousness and the one who guides the way.
In the Old Testament, Addai is mentioned as a high priest and a prophet, while Addir is a place name. This name is popular in various Western cultures, including English-speaking countries.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the belief that God provides righteousness and guidance in life.
